issues: Meaning drift: “DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA” should be rendered as “BY THE GRACE OF GOD THE ALMIGHTY” (missing “the”).
Meaning drift: “Menetapkan” is better rendered as “Stipulates/Determines” (not “Hereby Enacts”) to match the legal formula in the source.

Meaning drift: the phrase “Convention On The Elimination Of All Forms Of Discrimination Against Women” from the original is omitted in item 4 (the original includes the English convention title in parentheses).

Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 2: original has separate items 'd.' and 'e.' but translation uses 'd.' and 'e.' with an inserted 'and' that is not present as a marker issue in the source; also original shows 'dane. non diskriminasi' indicating 'dan e.' which must be preserved as item e.

Meaning drift in Article 2 item c: 'pengayoman' is closer to 'shelter/protection/guardianship' (protective guidance), while translation uses 'protection' which can overlap with 'perlindungan' but should reflect 'pengayoman' more precisely to avoid conflation in legal-indicator evaluation.
Meaning drift in Article 2 item c: "pengayoman" translated as "sheltering/protective guidance"; should be rendered as "protection" (principle of protection).
Minor meaning/grammar issue in Article 1 item 8: "any act unlawfully" is ungrammatical and slightly obscures meaning; should be "any unlawful act".

Scrambled/merged list markers in several places: Article 4 item d runs into e; after item l the conjunction and item m are merged ("andm."); Article 5 items g and h are merged ("danh."/"andh."); Article 6 items d and e are merged ("dane."/"ande."); Article 7 items e and f are merged ("andf."); Article 8 paragraph (2) is merged into paragraph (1) and its list intro is merged into item a; item b is merged into c ("andc.").

Meaning drift/awkward rendering: Article 5(a) mistranslates "penghormatan dan penggunaan sepenuhnya" (should be about respect for and full fulfillment of rights for survival/growth/development, not "full use").
Non-legal leftover pagination artifacts kept inline ("9 -", "10 -", "- 11 -") disrupting structure; should be removed from the translated legal text.

Scrambled/mismatched list/numbering markers in Article 8: original uses '1.' then '(2)' then '3.'; translation uses '1.' then '(2)' but should keep markers exactly as in original (including parentheses).
Meaning drift/grammar in Article 9: translation is a sentence fragment and omits the main predicate ('are ...'), weakening the normative statement.

Minor structure fidelity: original contains page-break artifacts ('9 -', '10 -', '- 11 -') and a merged marker ('danm.')—translation removed these; to preserve exact marker sequence for downstream splitting, these artifacts should be retained as plain text lines and the merged marker should be represented in order. (If your pipeline intentionally strips page numbers, you can ignore this, but per instructions we preserve markers.)

Scrambled/merged list structure: multiple list markers are run together without line breaks (e.g., 'include:a.', 'andf.', 'andg.', 'and/ orf.', 'andj.', 'andd.'), risking boundary-based parsing errors.
Broken numbering reference/meaning drift in Article 13(2): original refers to Article 12(3)(a), but translation incorrectly refers to Article 11(3)(a).
Leftover pagination artifacts ('13 -', '14 -', '15 -' and '- 12 -') included inside provisions; these are not legal text and should be removed for clean downstream evaluation.
Scrambled/mismatched numbering marker: Article 10 item (2) is not formatted as part of the numbered list (should be '2.' to match '(2)' in the original).
Meaning drift in Article 13(2): the translation references Article 12(3)(a), but the original incorrectly references Article 11(3)(a); translation must follow the original text.

Scrambled/merged list markers in several places: 'a./b./c.' and 'd./e.' are run together with missing spaces/newlines (e.g., 'ande. evaluation', 'andc.', 'andd.'), and 'in the form of:a.' is missing a space after the colon; this risks downstream list-boundary parsing.

Minor meaning drift/unnatural phrasing: 'PPA Implementation' duplicates the term ('pelaksanaan Penyelenggaraan PPA'); should be 'implementation of the administration/organization of PPA' (or similar) to reflect the original.

Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 18(2): original has subitems a–c on the same line as the clause, but translation splits them onto new lines; also original has 'dane. evaluasi' (d and e) which should be rendered as separate d. and e. items without losing the marker adjacency.

Meaning drift in Article 18(1): Indonesian states guidance and supervision of PPA 'from all forms of violence, discrimination, special protection and other issues' (i.e., in relation to those matters); translation reads as if PPA is being protected 'from special protection', which is nonsensical—should reflect that guidance/supervision covers violence, discrimination, special protection, and other issues.
Minor meaning drift/terminology in Article 27 signature line: 'Pj. BUPATI' is 'Acting Regent' (not left as 'Pj.').
